name: Well
header:
At the bottom of the well there is a door with a lock!
What do you do?

SeduceMessages.message: Your attempts to seduce the door are unsucessful.
The door turns a bright red but doesn't budge
You hear snickering behind the door as you try to seduce it
The door stands there, just being a door
You start to hear a sad tiny violin playing from seemingly no where
What are you doing? You beging to ask yourself
You think you see the handle blush, but it might've been the lighting.
The door remains unimpressed by you.
You wink at the door. The door does not wink back.
You swear the hinges sighed, but it might've been your pride escaping.
You try to whisper but bubbles just escape your mouth.
You caress the woodgrain lovingly. Splinters remind you of your mistakes.
The door looks at you, or it would if it had eyes, which it doesn't.
You feel your dignity leave you.
The door remains steadfast, an unfeeling guardian of boundaries and rejection.
You're pretty sure this isn't how locks work.
A bubles of awkwardness fills the water.
Somewhere, your ancestors sigh in disappointment.
You hear the narrator mutter, 'Really? The door?'
The door says nothing, but somehow, you can tell it's not interested.
